modules.title: Carry-on
modules.lede: Bags over these limits must be checked in at the airport counter before security.

carryon_bag_dimensions.value: One piece of carry-on baggage whose three dimensions total no more than 115 cm (55 cm × 40 cm × 25 cm).

carryon_weight.value: Up to 10 kg per person, including personal effects.

personal_item.value: One personal effect (handbag, camera, umbrella or similar) small enough to stow under the seat, in addition to the carry-on bag.

modules.title: Checked baggage
modules.lede: Baggage over the free allowance is charged at AIRDO's excess baggage rates.

allowance.value: A passenger paying an economy class fare gets a free checked baggage allowance of 20 kilograms (domestic conditions of carriage). Infants without a seat get no allowance of their own.

size_weight.value: Each checked piece up to 32 kilograms and 203 centimeters in total dimensions; total checked weight no more than 100 kilograms. Larger items need AIRDO's prior permission.

modules.title: If your flight is delayed or cancelled
modules.lede: These are AIRDO's terms in its conditions of carriage for passengers on domestic flights.

rebooking_refund.value: If AIRDO fails to perform the contract of carriage for reasons other than the passenger's request, you may choose: carriage to your destination on another AIRDO flight, another carrier's flight or other transport, with no fare difference collected; a refund (the full fare and charges before travel starts, or the unflown portion after); or an extension of the ticket's validity.

online_checkin.value: Online check-in opens 24 hours before departure; passengers who have checked in online can go straight to security.

bag_drop_cutoff.value: From Sep 1, 2026, the baggage check-in deadline at Haneda Airport is 30 minutes before departure.
